title: Manual A/B in the DAW: the exported rack and MIDI against apricity render
description:
## Intent

The initiative's acceptance: a step pattern sounds the same on the rack.

## Steps (owner, in the DAW)

1. `apricity export --kit b examples/chop-shop.apr --steps b -o /tmp/ab/b.adg`, and `apricity render examples/chop-shop.apr --bars 1-4 -o /tmp/ab/apricity.wav` with every other track muted (a copy of the score with only track `b`).
2. In the DAW: a MIDI track with `b.adg`, the `b.mid` clip under it, tempo from the score; export bars 1-4 as `/tmp/ab/daw.wav`.
3. Listen A/B. Then compare onsets and levels: `analysis/.venv/bin/python scripts/check-render.py` on both renders (tempo heard, beat deviation), and note the level difference per bar.
4. Record the differences expected from the warnings (none for this track) and any that are not expected.

## Verification

A comment with the DAW version, what was heard, the check-render numbers for both files, and a verdict. Unexpected differences become bugs under M1 or M2.

## Release

No commit.

## Dependencies

Blocked by the CLI task in this epic.
